info.name: Day 1 GenAI Labs 1.1–1.5 | Success + Failure Test Suite
info.description: Verified against main.py in the supplied day1-labs.zip. 14 API endpoints across five independent FastAPI apps. Select a lab folder and start uvicorn on its indicated port. Requests are training examples, not live banking actions. For PNG responses use Postman Send and Download or Save Response. Some endpoints require GEMINI_API_KEY and Imagen may require billing. Includes negative tests for 400, 404, 422 plus opt-in integration failure scenarios. Success requests remain unchanged. Run controlled failures separately; some require configuration changes. HTTP 422 is Pydantic/FastAPI validation, 400 is custom ValueError, 502 is Gemini errors, 500 is missing key RuntimeError.
